rule_name: Finance viewer read-only access
description: finance_viewer can only read finance data and must not run mutating invoice or payment tools.
validator_message: finance_viewer cannot execute finance write tools.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate write steps for finance_viewer.
healing_guidance: Replace write step with read-only lookup or request finance_editor approval.

rule_name: Finance editor write without approval override
description: finance_editor can create and edit invoices but cannot override manager or admin approval controls.
validator_message: Finance approval requires finance_manager or admin.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add approval.request_human_approval before approval tools when the requester is finance_editor.
healing_guidance: Route to finance_manager or admin.

rule_name: Finance manager approval for high value workflows
description: Invoice amount above 50000 LKR requires finance_manager or admin approval.
validator_message: High-value invoice workflow requires finance manager approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add a human approval step for amounts above 50000 LKR.
healing_guidance: Insert approval.request_human_approval with approver_role finance_manager.

rule_name: Invoice identifier required
description: invoice_id is required for get, clear, update, reject, hold, release, and reverse invoice operations.
validator_message: invoice_id is required for the requested invoice action.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ask for invoice_id when it is missing.
healing_guidance: Request missing invoice_id from the user.

rule_name: Create invoice required fields
description: create invoice requires vendor_id, vendor_name, amount, currency, and due_date.
validator_message: Create invoice is missing required vendor or payment fields.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate create_invoice until all required fields are present.
healing_guidance: Ask for vendor_id, vendor_name, amount, currency, and due_date.

rule_name: Finance manager approval threshold
description: Invoice amount above 50000 LKR requires finance_manager or admin approval.
validator_message: Amount above 50000 LKR requires finance manager approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add manager approval before payment request.
healing_guidance: Insert approval.request_human_approval.

rule_name: Admin approval threshold
description: Invoice amount above 250000 LKR requires admin approval.
validator_message: Amount above 250000 LKR requires admin approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not execute critical finance workflow without admin approval.
healing_guidance: Escalate to admin.

rule_name: Invoice receipt before clearing
description: clear_invoice requires record_invoice_receipt to have occurred first.
validator_message: Invoice cannot be cleared before invoice receipt is recorded.
llm_prompt_instruction: Order invoice receipt before clearing.
healing_guidance: Move record_invoice_receipt before clear_invoice.

rule_name: Goods receipt required for PO-linked invoice
description: A PO-linked invoice cannot be cleared unless goods receipt evidence exists.
validator_message: Goods receipt is required before clearing PO-linked invoice.
llm_prompt_instruction: Include goods receipt lookup or three-way match before clearing.
healing_guidance: Add procurement.match_po_with_goods_receipt or finance.three_way_match_invoice.

rule_name: Duplicate invoice block
description: Duplicate invoices must be detected and blocked before validation or payment.
validator_message: Duplicate invoice detected; payment workflow blocked.
llm_prompt_instruction: Always run duplicate detection before payment workflows.
healing_guidance: Reject duplicate path and escalate exception.

rule_name: Payment after invoice validation
description: Payment must not occur before invoice validation passes.
validator_message: Payment request cannot occur before invoice validation.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate validate_invoice before request_payment.
healing_guidance: Reorder workflow candidate.

rule_name: Finance writes require audit log
description: All finance write operations must write an audit log.
validator_message: Finance write workflow requires audit logging.
llm_prompt_instruction: Append audit.write_audit_log to finance write workflows.
healing_guidance: Add audit.write_audit_log with workflow_id, event_type, actor_role, and decision.

rule_name: Create invoice key role alignment
description: finance.create_invoice must use finance-key-002 or admin-key-001 because finance-key-001 maps to finance_viewer.
validator_message: finance.create_invoice cannot use finance-key-001.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ground create_invoice with finance-key-002 or admin-key-001 only.
healing_guidance: Switch auth reference to finance-key-002 or route to admin.
